summary: Standard BioTools Inc. filed an 8-K disclosing entry into a merger agreement with Treeline Biosciences Inc., combining the two companies in an all-stock merger. The merger will be effected via a subsidiary merger with Treeline surviving, followed by a name change to Treeline Biosciences Holdings, Inc. and a reverse stock split. All Treeline common and preferred stock will be converted into Standard BioTools common shares at an exchange ratio calculated per the agreement. The transaction is structured as a tax-free reorganization under Section 368(a). Watch for stockholder approval and Nasdaq listing requirements as key closing conditions.
